workspace.enableHint: Everyone in the workspace can use it, within their own permissions.

desktop.hint: Runs on their computer through the TeamOS desktop app, on their own Claude plan.
desktop.title: Each person's own Claude Code

server.hint: Uses the Claude Code installed and signed in where TeamOS runs.
server.title: Claude Code on the TeamOS server

workspace.serverFound: Claude Code found on the server
workspace.serverMissing: Claude Code isn't installed on the server
workspace.title: Ask TeamOS in {{name}}

teammates.description: Claude on a schedule, working with your permissions. Suggest: it drafts changes for you to review. Act: it applies them, and you can undo.
teammates.instructionsPlaceholder: Anything to add, in any language. e.g. Only look at Mobile App; write in Bangla.

overdue.hint: A friendly comment on each overdue task asking its owner for an update.
overdue.title: Overdue nudger

standup.hint: Yesterday / today / blocked for each person, from time and task changes.
standup.title: Standup

triage.hint: Gives unowned, unprioritised tasks a priority and an owner by workload.
triage.title: Triage

weekly.hint: Done, slipped, time per project and risks for next week.
weekly.title: Weekly report

act.hint: Applies its changes; you can undo them
act.title: Act

suggest.hint: Drafts changes for you to review and apply
suggest.title: Suggest

teammates.noChannel: Don't post; just send me the result
teammates.started: Started. You'll get a notification when it's done.
teammates.title: AI teammates

registrationSetup.subtitle: Whether new people can create an account on this server. Only you can see this.
registrationSetup.title: Registration
registrationSetup.toggleHelp: When this is off, an account can only be created from a valid workspace invitation. The very first signup on an empty server is always allowed, so setup never locks you out.

callback.errorSubtitle: Sign-in links are single-use and expire after two minutes. Start again to get a fresh one.
callback.subtitle: Finishing up with your browser session.
callback.title: Signing you in

handoff.doneSubtitle: The desktop app is taking over. You can close this tab.
handoff.error: Could not hand your session to the desktop app. Try again.
handoff.invalidSubtitle: Open the desktop app and start sign-in from there so it can verify the request.
handoff.signInSubtitle: Sign in, and the desktop app picks up from here.
handoff.subtitle: Continue as {{email}} in the desktop app.
handoff.title: Open TeamOS Desktop

signIn.hint: Come back here once your browser says you're done.
signIn.subtitle: Signing in opens your browser, where TeamOS already knows you.
signIn.title: Sign in to TeamOS
